Card Q&A.q: When this card's effect places 1 of my other blue Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, what happens to that Digimon's digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a:
It's not being trashed by the effect, it's being trashed because of the rules, so [BT9-109 X Antibody] does still get trashed.

Card Q&A.q: When this card's effect places 1 of my other blue Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, if that Digimon has [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards, what happens to that card?
